checks.name: Real blank click validates five fields and focuses the first field
Native Enter prevents navigation, respects trimmed limits and keeps values
Invalid edit removes the previous confirmation
Browser file chooser selection, removal and same-file reselection
Invalid batch and fourth attachment are rejected without losing previous files
Layout 393px with long filename, errors and three attachments
Layout 320px with long filename, errors and three attachments
Layout 1280px with long filename, errors and three attachments
Rejected attachment error clears after deletion and revalidation of the retained valid selection
Keyboard reaches close, required inputs, attachment removal and confirmation
No submission/upload requests, navigation, persistent-storage writes or location requests
Reload does not restore a draft or selected attachments

limitations: Chrome file chooser automation exercises native file selection events; the OS dialog itself and a screen reader were not manually operated.
Viewport checks are not real mobile device, touch keyboard, safe-area or screen-reader validation.
